questions.question:
Complete the Cypher query that the AI might generate after using the get-neo4j-schema tool to understand the database structure:

-- select -- (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE m.imdbRating > 8.0
RETURN u.name, m.title, r.rating
Why does the read-neo4j-cypher tool execute queries within read transactions?
options: To prevent the tool from modifying or deleting data.

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of using the get-neo4j-schema tool before generating Cypher queries?
options: It prevents the LLM from hallucinating incorrect schema elements.
It backs up the database schema.
It reduces the query execution time.

questions.question: What is the role of a Host in the MCP architecture?
options: To manage one or more clients and maintain session state.
To translate natural language into tool calls.
To execute Cypher queries against Neo4j databases.
To store MCP tool definitions in a central registry.
To provide authentication for MCP servers.
